\section[(dialogue)]{Time, numbers and verbs — a first pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R136-first-pass-time-numbers-and-verbs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to find and to look for.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item serious, right, wrong, ready, safe; sure
  \item dangerous, wet, dry, cool; fresh, soft
  \item hard, round, wide, narrow; tight, angry
  \item bitter, salty, light, heavy, thin
  \item the weekend, a date, a century, often, sometimes
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Serious? (\textbf{serio}.) Right? (\textbf{giusto}.) Wrong? (\textbf{sbagliato}.) Ready? (\textbf{pronto}.) Safe; sure? (\textbf{sicuro}.) Dangerous? (\textbf{pericoloso}.) Wet? (\textbf{bagnato}.) Dry? (\textbf{asciutto}.) Cool; fresh? (\textbf{fresco}.) Soft? (\textbf{morbido}.) Hard? (\textbf{duro}.) Round? (\textbf{rotondo}.) Wide? (\textbf{largo}.) Narrow; tight? (\textbf{stretto}.) Angry? (\textbf{arrabbiato}.) Bitter? (\textbf{amaro}.) Salty? (\textbf{salato}.) Light? (\textbf{leggero}.) Heavy? (\textbf{pesante}.) Thin? (\textbf{magro}.) The weekend? (\textbf{il fine settimana}.) A date? (\textbf{la data}.) A century? (\textbf{il secolo}.) Often? (\textbf{spesso}.) Sometimes? (\textbf{qualche volta}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{More verbs — a second pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R136-second-pass-more-verbs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for zero and sixty.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item zero, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety
  \item to begin, to visit, to put, to believe, to drive
  \item to get dressed, to wash, to get up, to sit down, to fall
  \item to go up, to go down, to stay, to rent, to repair
  \item to tell, to walk, to clean, to find, to look for
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Zero? (\textbf{zero}.) Sixty? (\textbf{sessanta}.) Seventy? (\textbf{settanta}.) Eighty? (\textbf{ottanta}.) Ninety? (\textbf{novanta}.) To begin? (\textbf{cominciare}.) To visit? (\textbf{visitare}.) To put? (\textbf{mettere}.) To believe? (\textbf{credere}.) To drive? (\textbf{guidare}.) To get dressed? (\textbf{vestirsi}.) To wash? (\textbf{lavarsi}.) To get up? (\textbf{alzarsi}.) To sit down? (\textbf{sedersi}.) To fall? (\textbf{cadere}.) To go up? (\textbf{salire}.) To go down? (\textbf{scendere}.) To stay? (\textbf{restare}.) To rent? (\textbf{affittare}.) To repair? (\textbf{riparare}.) To tell? (\textbf{raccontare}.) To walk? (\textbf{camminare}.) To clean? (\textbf{pulire}.) To find? (\textbf{trovare}.) To look for? (\textbf{cercare}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
